questions.question: Where did Israel set up the tent of meeting and divide the rest of the land?
How did Joshua divide the remaining land among the seven tribes?
options: By which tribe had fought best in war
By the age of the tribal leaders
By casting lots before the LORD
By the size of each tribe's army
questions.answer: By casting lots before the LORD

questions.question: Joshua sent men to survey the land and describe it before dividing it.
The tent of meeting was set up at _____, where the land was divided.
Joshua cast _____ for the tribes before the LORD to assign their land.
